claim_verdicts.evidence: Exposition formats: sample line = `... value [ timestamp ]` (one value per sample). Overview: "Prometheus collects and stores its metrics as time series data, i.e. metrics information is stored with the timestamp at which it was recorded." Live: two consecutive curls returned 2/1 then 3/2 for the products lines — one current value each, no history.

Exposition formats: HELP -> metric name then docstring; "If the token is `TYPE`, exactly two more tokens are expected. The first is the metric name, and the second is either `counter`, `gauge`, ...". Metric types: "A counter is a cumulative metric that represents a single monotonically increasing counter whose value can only increase or be reset to zero on restart." "a value that only goes up" is fine given the lesson scopes values to "since the API started".

HELP (HttpRequestCountMiddleware, and live output): "Provides the count of HTTP requests that have been processed by the ASP.NET Core pipeline." Live: `http_requests_received_total{code="200",method="GET",controller="Products",action="Get",endpoint="api/v1/products/{id:int}"} 4`, same with code="404" -> 2; /health/ready line has controller="",action="". README: captures "the `action`, `controller` and `endpoint` route parameters".
